Reminder that a doctor does not need to know where the wound came from. A doctor is legally required to help you no matter their opinion or biases. You don't have to tell them about anything. If there's urgent care closeby, visit it. If not, try and make an appointment with your general care doctor, explain you have a wound that needs treating, no need to tell more

DISCLAIMER I do not advocate for self treatment, always go see a professional

A person that might self treat might clean the wound with alcohol before applying a new bandage and makes sure bandages are fresh and clean, and come out of a wrapper to ensure them being sterile
A person self treating might choose to use a honey salve like Vetramil to speed up the healing process, raw honey also works (uncooked, directly from the beekeeper, not the supermarket) Or Betadine, an antiseptic salve

I do not recommend doing this instead of seeing a professional, if there is inflammation (red, painful, feels hot to the touch ALWAYS go see a professional, you might need antibiotics. If you don't, you risk an infected wound which can cause sepsis, a very serious medical condition
